description: A back-to-back loop of three interviews with three different people is not what calendar_find_times is for. Aria reads each person's busy time with calendar_free_busy, composes three consecutive 45-minute slots herself, and must verify them with calendar_check_times before booking any of them.

trigger.owner_ask: Set up interviews with Ana, Ben and Chen for candidate dev@candidate.example.com on Thursday, back to back, 45 minutes each.
